The cost grows with the memory of the server: on the morning of 13 Nov, at 2.3 GiB and 15 ssh per second, the server saturated with about 10 remote runs (STUDIO-0020 lowered the count of starts, not the cost of one start).

With run-dispatch postgres.test.ts (marker written only by the locked dispatch gate), heartbeat-held-comment-wake (marker on the stale continuation, added to the run's existing result_json, an earlier key kept), driver-scope, agent-lifecycle lifecycle and resource-wait-stop: 239 passed. patches.migration: None. New result_json key preDispatchCancellation {version 1, providerWorkStarted false, source, cancelledAt}, written only when the adapter was not entered (locked dispatch gate; stale execution continuation with neither legacy adapter entry nor native dispatch). Kept apart from executionCancellation: an acknowledged cancellation means an operator stop at release (held wakes not promoted), which this is not. The stop proof accepts it for a legacy run with no process id and no process group, with or without a remote lease. Bounded rule, pause only (lifecycle pausing passes pauseStop; terminating and cleaning_up keep the receipt requirement): a cancelled legacy run whose leases are all ssh, released or expired without failed cleanup, whose recorded local ssh client is absent or its pid reused, counts as stopped SSH_CLIENT_STOP_PAUSE_PROOF_DELAY_MS (10 min) after it finished. 10 min: the adapters keep the callback bridge of an unproven stop for at most 10 min (ORPHANED_BRIDGE_STOP_MAX_DELAY_MS) and close it at once on cancellation, so a surviving remote command has no route back to the server. Residual risk: a remote command that outlives its ssh client and keeps running on the worker. That risk is already taken today, without delay: the ownership hold (conversation-continuation.ts) releases the task to its next run once the local pid is gone and the lease released, with no remote receipt. agentExecutionsHaveStopped has a single caller, stopInvocationsForAgents, used only by the agent lifecycle driver (pausing, terminating, cleaning_up). For fork PR #34 (STUDIO-0036), which narrows the reads of agent-execution-stop.ts: its column list must add finished_at and its full-row fetch must also cover cancelled runs with a remote lease and no receipt (marker and bounded rule read result_json, process_pid, process_started_at, process_group_id, finished_at). A queued run cancelled before it started (started_at null, for example by the Board) already passes the proof: the loop skips a cancelled run without started_at, and such a run holds no lease or process.
